# BluePilot: the upstream files full BluePilot may change (#224). "Upstream" is this repo's bp-sunnypilot
# branch. Every file that exists there and differs from it in a PR's merge result must be listed here,
# with the reason; anything else fails the bluepilot-hooks check. Prefer moving code into a BluePilot file
# (bluepilot/, openpilot/selfdrive/ui/bp/) to adding a line.

.gitattributes                                                                         # BluePilot's own binaries are plain git files, not LFS
.gitignore                                                                             # local agent docs and tools
README.md                                                                              # BluePilot's README
launch_chffrplus.sh                                                                    # boot logo

opendbc_repo                                                                           # points at ford-op/opendbc bp-full (BluePilot's Ford car code), not bp-opendbc
